# Joe Monceballez — Homes In Corpus

> Joe Monceballez is a Corpus Christi, Texas Realtor (ValTex Realty, TREC License #0586828), active real estate investor, and the contractor who runs the renovations on his own properties. 99 homes closed. Rated 5.0 on Zillow (7 reviews) and 5.0 on Google (4 reviews). Bilingual English/Spanish, available 24/7. He lists homes, represents buyers at no cost to them, makes direct cash offers on houses as-is, takes on remodeling and handyman work for homeowners, and advises on pre-sale renovations. Service area: Corpus Christi, Portland, Calallen, Flour Bluff, Rockport, Ingleside, Robstown, Aransas Pass, and North Padre Island, TX. Call or text (361) 960-1779, or email joe@homesincorpus.com.

## What Joe does
- **Lists homes for sale** — full-service listing with ValTex Realty, priced and marketed for top dollar
- **Buys houses for cash, as-is** — no repairs, no cleanout, no showings; for inherited homes, foreclosure situations, and houses that need work
- **Represents buyers** — the seller pays the buyer's agent, so Joe's help typically costs a buyer nothing
- **Remodeling and handyman work for homeowners** — kitchens, bathrooms, tile, and flooring across the Coastal Bend; free estimates
- **Pre-sale renovation advice** — as a contractor, he identifies which repairs actually raise a home's sale price
- **Investment and wholesale deals** — he buys, renovates, and resells, and wholesales off-market deals to his investor network
